_comment: The canonical id list for this org. refresh-metrics.sh reads ids from here and never re-derives them from the catalog, so a marketplace rename cannot silently drop a row. Order is display order in the README.

plugins.name: Bazaar
plugins.pitch: The Omarchy marketplace in your bar. Search every listing, filter by category or kind, rank what is trending, save a private shortlist, inspect source, and copy safe install commands.

plugins.name: Pit Wall
plugins.pitch: A Formula 1 race-weekend command post with countdowns, live order, gaps, flags, safety-car state, local-time schedules, and championship standings.

plugins.name: Wait State
plugins.pitch: CPU, memory, and I/O pressure stalls in the bar, with bounded history and practical guidance so busy is not mistaken for blocked.

plugins.name: MLB Booth
plugins.pitch: Follow one MLB club from first-pitch countdown through the final out with score, inning, count, outs, bases, schedule, and division race.

plugins.name: X Files
plugins.pitch: Replies to your own X posts as a drainable queue of questions, gripes, and asks, with representative quotes and a hard API-spend cap.

plugins.name: Docket
plugins.pitch: GitHub pull requests as an obligation queue: reviews waiting on you, your blocked work, and branches ready to merge, oldest first.

plugins.name: Crew Chief
plugins.pitch: Claude Code, Codex, Herdr, and other agent sessions as a local attention queue. See working, blocked, and done, then focus the project that needs you.

plugins.name: Listening Post
plugins.pitch: Twenty-nine curated AI-vendor feeds in a four-lane radar for model releases, price changes, status incidents, and engineering posts.

plugins.name: Desk Transition
plugins.pitch: Two safe Hyprland display actions: arrange active outputs left-to-right or focus the built-in panel, with a preview before anything changes.

plugins.name: Foundry
plugins.pitch: Turn an ID, name, and pitch into a proof-ready Omarchy bar-widget draft with matched manifest copy, a unique banner, offline tests, CI, and security gates.

plugins.name: Loose Ends
plugins.pitch: Scan local Git repositories for uncommitted edits, unpushed commits, old stashes, detached heads, and interrupted operations, oldest first.

plugins.name: Capture Conveyor
plugins.pitch: Turn Omarchy screenshots into a keyboard-first inbox: view recent captures, capture or OCR a region, copy paths, and reveal files.

plugins.name: Workspace Storyboard
plugins.pitch: Turn live Hyprland workspaces into a local re-entry map with window counts, active titles, keyboard jumps, and a private context history.

plugins.name: Quiet Queue
plugins.pitch: A trustworthy 25- or 50-minute focus switch that uses native Do Not Disturb and restores notification delivery only when it owns the session.

plugins.name: Flow Boundary
plugins.pitch: Mark intentional starts and stops from the bar with a live FLOW or PAUSE state and a bounded local transition history.

plugins.name: omaTrail
plugins.pitch: An offline frontier survival game for Omarchy with hunting, river crossings, resource management, and a choice of Green Monitor or Color Deluxe graphics.

template.name: Widget Template
template.pitch: The skeleton every entry above is built from. BarWidget, Panel, a node-testable Model.js, the 12-gate pre-submit lane and CI, so a new widget starts already passing.
